texts.facts: The Committee submitted its report to the State Government on 29 th June, 2024. Based on the recommendations of the Committee, the State Government cancelled the suspension order on 01st July, 2024 and issued a fresh notice to show cause to the respondent No.5 on 08th July, 2024. Around 40 parties had participated in the said meeting.
